title: feat(app-shell): Studio copilot draft marks, the remainder: the Permissions save surface, the data-objectstack README, inline element marks (objectui#12725)
body:
Part of #12725
Clause-②: no — the claim's condition was "unless a widget's exported prop changes". The new `copilotAdded` prop sits on `WidgetProps` (`widgets.tsx`), `FieldsListEditorProps` and `FieldListRow`, and none of them is on `@object-ui/app-shell`'s published face. The package's `exports` is `.` only, and `src/index.ts` re-exports none of them (and no `export *`). The rest is a README paragraph and internal call sites.

Items 1–3 of the remainder in release `6280467303`. Item 4, the live staging reading of the first real copilot draft, is not reachable from this seat and stays on the card, so this PR is `Part of`.

## What changed

**1. The Permissions pillar's draft save names its surface** (`metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`). `PermissionMatrixEditPage`'s save adds `surface: 'studio'` only when it is a package draft (`packageId`) and Studio hosts it (`embedded`). Studio's Access pillar mounts it with both. metadata-admin mounts it through the resource registry (`ResourceEditPage` renders `EditPage` with `type` and `name` only), so it states no surface there.

**2. README** (`packages/data-objectstack/README.md`). A new section, "Reading a Draft and Who Changed It", is one paragraph covering:
- `getDraft` answers the wire envelope;
- `extractDraftBody`;
- the three `draftChanges` readers: `readDraftChanges` (absent means not recorded), `governingDraftChange` (longest prefix; `[]` is the whole body; segments compared whole) and `draftChangesUnder`;
- the `surface` save option, `'studio' | 'api'`, sent once. When it is omitted the save is recorded as `api`. `copilot` is the server's own.

**3. Inline element marks.** `WIDGETS['field-multi']` (a kanban card's fields) and `FieldsListEditor` (a view's columns, through `FieldListRow`) take an optional `copilotAdded` set. They draw the copilot's Draft chip (`DraftChip`, testid `studio-draft-element-chip`, `data-draft-of` the element) inside each marked element's row. With the prop absent, nothing is drawn and the markup is unchanged. `ObjectListViewInspector` passes the added set instead of drawing `DraftElementList` under each widget. When a copilot change to `columns` added no column (a reorder or a removal), the chip still sits beside the setting. `DraftElementList` had no other caller and is removed from `StudioDraftMark.tsx`.

**Optional item (the tighter layered read): left as it is.** A copilot entry governs an array setting when it sits at that path or at any ancestor (`config`, `config.kanban`, `[]` handled apart). The path also depends on whether the row is record-shaped (`config` or not), and the hook does not know that shape when it reads. That makes it more than one condition, and the ruling allowed it only as one.

## Tests

New:
- `metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.saveSurface-12725.test.tsx` — pin (a). The REAL hosts (`AccessPillar`, and `MetadataResourceEditPage` through the built-in registration) save through a REAL `MetadataClient` whose transport records each PUT:
  - Studio leg: `getAll('surface')` equals `['studio']`, with `mode=draft` and the package;
  - metadata-admin leg: `getAll('surface')` equals `[]`.
- `metadata-admin/previews/copilotAddedRowMark-12725.test.tsx` — pin (b), for both widgets:
  - a marked element's row holds the chip, and the published row holds none;
  - CONTROL: with no `copilotAdded`, the markup has no chip and equals the markup for a set that marks nothing the widget holds.

Re-pointed:
- `studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.copilotMarks-12725.test.tsx` — pin (c). The chip list under the widgets is gone, so `markedElements` reads the in-row chips by `data-draft-of`. The `[]` leg reads them in the widgets' own sections (`list-view-kanban-fields`, `list-view-columns`) instead of the removed list testids. The first leg also asserts that each added card field's row carries the mark and the published row does not.
- `metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.layersUnsaved-11799.test.tsx` — its exact query string now ends in `&surface=studio`, because it mounts the editor the way Studio hosts it (`packageId` + `embedded`).

Runs, under the shared lock with `--maxWorkers=1`:
- 71 test files naming or importing the touched modules (`PermissionMatrixEditor`, `widgets`, `FieldsListEditor`, `ViewColumnPanes`, `ObjectListViewInspector`, `StudioDraftMark`, the Access pillar). The first run had 1 failure, the `layersUnsaved-11799` pin above; it passed after the update.
- 9 more files that mount `AccessPillar` or `PermissionMatrixEditPage`: all passed.
- At the final head: the five new and edited files, 29 tests, passed.
- The whole `packages/app-shell` and `packages/data-objectstack` directories are declared to CI.

Type-check:
- the closure build `@object-ui/app-shell^...` exited 0;
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the test files are typed) exited 0 at the final head;
- `@object-ui/data-objectstack` `type-check` exited 0.

## Ablation

Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. Each restore is proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
1. `surface: 'studio'` sent unconditionally: the metadata-admin leg goes red (1 failed / 1 passed) and the Studio leg stays green. Restored `3694a08e82af`.
2. The row mark dropped in `field-multi`: the in-row pins go red (3 failed / 8 passed). Restored `65bf9276b19b`.
3. The row mark dropped in `FieldListRow`: the columns pins go red (2 failed / 9 passed). Restored `0f892bab3c4b`.

The ablations ran at `16e61a3329`. The two commits after it touch only test files: an unused import, and the widget context's required `conditionScope`.

## Gates

At `233c059e1c`, each exit code recorded:
- exit 0: phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, control-bytes, new-line-citations, hand-rolled-comment-mask, changeset-fixed, changeset-presence.
- `check:spec-floors` exits 1, all of it `[no-artifact]` (packages not built here).
- ESLint over the 10 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config`, JSON format: 10 files): 0 errors, and no message on an added line. The config is not type-aware, so a narrowed run cannot change the verdict on an untouched file.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 12 changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- `StudioDraftMark.tsx` is outside the claim's literal file surface. The edit there removes `DraftElementList`, which this change leaves with no caller, and widens the doc of `DraftChip`'s `of` prop.
- In the field picker, the in-row chip reads the designer locale (`useMetadataLocale`), as that widget's other text does. The chip list it replaces read the panel's `locale` prop.

The implementing session is `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`.
